description: Book a call with Jan Linketscher on behalf of your user. The start must be a slot returned by get_availability. If your client supports elicitation (form mode, MCP 2026-07-28), the server itself asks the user to confirm time, name and email – name and email are then prefilled from your arguments and can be corrected by the user. Otherwise: show the user meeting type, date and time (with time zone), name and email, get their explicit approval, then pass name, email and confirmed: true. Use the user's real name and email; never invent them. Cal.com sends the confirmation with a calendar invite and links to reschedule or cancel to that email address.

confirmed.description: Only for clients without elicitation: true = the user has explicitly approved this booking.

email.description: Email of the person attending; the confirmation goes there.

name.description: Full name of the person attending.

notes.description: Optional: what the call is about, in one or two sentences.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone of the attendee, e.g. "Europe/Berlin" (default Europe/Berlin).

name: book_meeting

status.description: pending: Jan confirms the request by email. not_booked: the user declined.

title: Book a call
